mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in FEDFUNDS above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity discount rates and compressing risk premiums, which produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced cash flow valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 300 indicates persistent inflationary pressure, triggering central bank rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and reduce forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 300, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in INDPRO below 102 and rise in FEDFUNDS above 3.0% indicates supply contraction coupled with monetary tightening, reducing corporate profit margins and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances meeting the dual trigger condition, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals labor market overheating, triggering inflationary wage pressures that reduce equity earnings yields and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the regime-specific signal fails to outperform baseline returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 22000) indicates robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings and investor confidence, which consistently generates positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 22000, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1500 units signals housing market overheating, which correlates with consumer spending exhaustion (RSAFS < 650000), reducing disposable income and generating negative S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of cases meeting the dual trigger, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 in 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-labor-activity regimes (PAYEMS > 150000), UNRATE below 3.5% indicates tight labor markets that accelerate wage inflation, increasing corporate costs and reducing equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases when PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 295), FEDFUNDS rising above 3.5% triggers aggressive rate hikes that increase real borrowing costs, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 295 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the regime-specific signal fails to show statistical significance (p > 0.05).
